description: The Anti-Shipping Activity Messages (ASAM) archive records hostile acts against ships and mariners worldwide, as point events on a map. The records were sourced from the US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency and are shared as a layer in Esri's Living Atlas. Coverage is global. The layer can be viewed and queried in ArcGIS under the Esri Master License; it is free to use there. Caveats: funding for ASAM ended on 30 June 2024 and the archive is no longer updated, and the Office of Naval Intelligence now publishes its reports as PDF documents; reporting also depends on what incidents were passed to NGA. The events support exposure analysis of shipping routes and ports to maritime security threats and scenario building for disruption of sea lanes. They complement the AIS track data catalogued here, which describe normal shipping routes.
